summary: Chunk p05/ch08 units 1-50 reviewed word by word against the print and Devanagari. Main errors: invented word 'oṣadhāni/oṣadhānām' for printed auṣadhāni (units 20, 38); translations built on conjectures without the required hedge (2 'gently', 17 'heartwoods', 28 'गोबर', 29 horn/hoof); wrong typo suggestion in 22 (hiatus, not o); unflagged emendations (2 praśasyaṃtaiti, 24 sakṣīraṇi, 38 ākalathya, 36 samasta space). Identifications kuśa, pippalī, viḍaṅga (standard) and rohiṣa (disputed, hedged) accepted; no wrong identification found. Human decisions: 30 (kaṣāya as 'decoction' for a set of five forms), 23 (nivāta-pravāta-eka-deśa), 46 (vyavasthānam vs vyavasthā na), 2 (damaged mṛdāvaphāla split), 25 negation.
glossary_suggestions: kaṣāya in 'pañcavidhaḥ kaṣāyaḥ' = a general 'preparation' (the five include juice and paste); fix this wording for the book.
A conjectural reading of a damaged word needs the hedge in BOTH Hindi and English wherever the translation depends on it (e.g. 'horn' in unit 29).
Do not turn an accusative adjective into a condition ('होने पर') in Hindi; no modal 'सकेंगे' for a future.
śakṛt = 'dung' (Hindi मल), not गोबर unless the animal is a cow.
